name: Compass Rose (Shipwreck)
description: Older shipwreck north of the cloister — source of the zombies plaguing the beach. Several ships have crashed here; the latest veered off course suddenly (witnessed by Varnoth and Rix). Cursed cargo in the hold animates drowned sailors.
itemsOfInterest: C3 Wheel — 'Compass Rose' engraved; noise attracts C4 zombies
C4 Captain's Quarters — 50 gp, tools, compass, dagger
C6 Crew Quarters — trapped floorboard, 200 gp, lovers' portrait
C9 Hold — captain's chest, curse heart
notes: Breaking the hold curse stops new beach zombies. Can be done before or after Seagrow Caves (party choice).
